_contract: Intent-level accuracy probes (project rule: THE CORRECTNESS RULE in TESTING_PROMPT.md). `expects` describes the USER INTENT a correct answer must satisfy — concept, country, frequency (when the query names one), and a plausible value shape. Provider/series mentions are NON-BINDING hints: multiple different series can each be a correct answer, and an unexpected id is never a failure by itself. Verdicts: CORRECT / CORRECT-HONEST (honest not-available + latest date) / GOOD-ASK (>=2 materially distinct executable options) / WRONG-SERIES (data answers a different question) / WRONG-VALUES / BAD-ASK (no real choice, unnecessary, or repeated) / ERROR-EMPTY.
_usage: POST each query to /api/query sequentially (never parallel); for multi-round pass conversationId from the prior response. Clear openecon:* Redis keys first for cold-cache truth. Cross-check load-bearing values against authoritative sources.
